summary: Full regression test after long feature session. All 15 backend tests pass (Supabase auth, /api/v2/school/leaderboard, /api/v2/school/today, PATCH /api/v2/students/{id}/status incl. invalid-status 400, /api/v2/billing/checkout returning a valid checkout.stripe.com URL, health). Frontend verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): (a) Auth screen redesign — 'Register' label, password Eye/EyeOff toggle flips input type from password→text; (b) Owner dashboard — KPIs render (3 Active students, 2 Lessons mo, £0 Revenue, 0% Pass rate), Students-in-arrears tile renders with 'All pupil payments are up to date.' empty state, is tappable, navigates to /student-crm-screen?filter=arrears; (c) Arrears filter — red 'Arrears Active' chip with X, 'All up to date' empty state visible; (d) Privacy toggle — after tapping the eye next to Revenue KPI, £••• mask appears on the dashboard (verified in DOM); (e) CRM chips 'All / Active / Test Ready / New / Passed / Waitlist' all rendered; (f) Diary FAB 'btn-add-lesson' opens AddLessonSheet with topic field as optional; (g) Student lifecycle Deactivate → immediate status flip to 'Inactive' + non-blocking snackbar 'Jon Kenny marked as inactive. UNDO' + Reactivate button appears and works. APScheduler dispatch_lesson_reminders confirmed executing every 5 minutes via backend logs.

integration_issues.issue: Supabase REST returns HTTP 400 for three queries on load (dvsa_syllabus_tracking, lessons, test_outcomes). Root screen still renders and does not crash — this is graceful degradation. Likely a column-select mismatch or RLS policy the owner-viewing-another-instructor's-student doesn't match. Non-blocking but the console errors are noisy.

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Recurring during Metro bundle & every screen render. Reference: multiple screens' StyleSheet.create blocks.
Web console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: sign-up-login-screen render path (fired during sign-in).
Expo doctor reports 'expo@54.0.35 - expected version: ~54.0.36'. Minor drift; recommend `yarn add expo@~54.0.36`.

action_items: (P3) Investigate the 3 Supabase 400s on student-lifecycle-screen (dvsa_syllabus_tracking, lessons, test_outcomes) — likely a column or foreign-key select that no longer matches migration 015 (test_outcomes) or 001 (dvsa_syllabus_tracking). App is graceful, but the console noise hides real errors.
(P4) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' across screens (owner-dashboard, student-crm, sign-up-login etc.). Non-blocking but pollutes console.
(P4) Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop on TouchableOpacity/View with style.pointerEvents.
(P4) Bump expo from 54.0.35 to ~54.0.36 per expo doctor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2080 lines and hosts 40+ endpoints in one file — recommend splitting per-domain (auth, billing, school, students, receipts, calendar) into routers under backend/routers/. Not urgent but the file has crossed the 700-line 'file-too-large' threshold from the review guidelines.

v2/billing/checkout hits Stripe LIVE mode (STRIPE_API_KEY starts with sk_live_). During tests the endpoint returned a genuine https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL; no payment was completed. Consider a STRIPE_MODE env flag so QA can point at test-mode without env swaps.

get_current_supabase_user calls Supabase /auth/v1/user on every request. Fine for now but a signed-JWT verify (using SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET, already in env) would cut ~150 ms per authenticated call. Not a blocker.
AddLessonSheet.tsx: clash-check path silently falls through on Supabase errors (line 212–214) — matches design intent but log to console for observability.

Owner-dashboard revenue-privacy toggle stores boolean in AsyncStorage under 'adi_pro_revenue_privacy_mode'. Value is app-local (not tied to user id), so switching accounts on the same device inherits the previous user's privacy state. Minor UX polish.
